examples/complex.why:
MathJax can't parse the macros that split comma-separated arguments (\cvc, \rvc, \mat and \passtonextarg), and the build can't see the large operators a command of the document's defines (\Sum and co.); tex4ht writes a stray

in a multicols of tcolorbox listings, so make4ht reads the page as HTML, as a browser does
allow: left undefined for MathJax, which can't read their definitions: \cvc
15 macro(s) MathJax doesn't know, shown in red: \Capp, \Coprod, \Cupp, \Kupp, \Odot, \Oplus, \Otimes, \Prod, \Sum, \Uplus, \Vee, \Wedge, \cvc, \mat, \rvc.

test-htmlread.why: the fixture writes a stray , so make4ht reads the page as HTML, as a browser does: its text must stay as in the PDF

test-units-nocolor.why: siunitx.4ht loads the color package after tex4ht has configured the packages, so the page has no colors; tex8web says so, and that xcolor is needed
allow: Package tex8web Warning: The color package was loaded after the preamble

test-nestpic.why: the footnote of a minipage in a box that a TikZ picture draws is written after the text, and its link back goes to its mark, which is drawn in the picture. A box with no picture in it does the same.

test-nestpic-hyperref.why: the footnote of a minipage in a box that a TikZ picture draws is written after the text, and its link back goes to its mark, which is drawn in the picture. A box with no picture in it does the same.

test-quantikz-red.why: a known gap of its own: a display with two quantikz circuits is left to MathJax, as one with two other pictures is, and MathJax has no quantikz environment
